reading.format: Five courses with lecture videos, quizzes, and ungraded labs.
reading.summary: The Deep Learning Specialization is a five-course program created and taught by Andrew Ng. It covers building and training neural networks from the ground up, including convolutional and sequence models. Learners apply these models to computer vision and natural language processing tasks using Python and TensorFlow. The program also includes a course on running machine learning projects, covering error diagnosis and prioritization.
reading.audience: It is for anyone who wants a rigorous foundation in deep learning rather than a surface-level tour. It suits software engineers moving into AI, data scientists who want to understand what happens under the hood, and early-career or aspiring ML engineers building an industry portfolio.
reading.prerequisites: Comfort with Python and basic linear algebra is required. Prior machine learning experience is helpful but not required.
